turns.instruction: Model the 10 m beam with the attached properties. The 0–4 m region uses M1, but the 4–10 m region is simultaneously assigned M1 and M2 in the supplied records. A downward 9 kN/m load covers x=2–8 m, a downward 25 kN point force acts at x=6 m, and a global Y moment of -8 kN*m acts at the right end. Request Uz at x=5 m and right-support Rz. Resolve the conflicting material assignment before reporting numerical results.

Confirm M1 on x=0–4 m and M2 on x=4–10 m. Analyze and report signed Uz at x=5 m and Rz at the right support x=10 m, with direction, units, D case and turn 2. Preserve the load interval, the 25 kN point force and the -8 kN*m global Y end moment.

Replace the 25 kN point force at x=6 m by 35 kN downward. Reanalyze and report the same Uz and right-support Rz for D, turn 3. Keep the material boundary at x=4 m, the 9 kN/m load on x=2–8 m, and the -8 kN*m global Y right-end moment unchanged.
